zh.title: 長榮航空獲7項永續獎 永續報告書首獲全球企業永續獎金獎
zh.summary: 長榮航空今年獲7項永續獎，全球企業永續獎報告書獎首獲金獎。
body: 長榮航空表示，今年在臺灣企業永續獎獲得7項大獎，其中全球企業永續獎（GCSA）的永續報告書獎首度獲得金獎。臺灣永續能源研究基金會舉行2026年第19屆臺灣企業永續獎頒獎典禮。
長榮航空其他獎項包括臺灣百大永續典範企業獎、永續報告書白金獎，以及永續供應鏈領袖獎和社會共融領袖獎。
長榮航空表示，與長榮空廚合作回收廢食用油，由臺塑石化以共煉製程轉化為永續航空燃油（SAF），再用於長榮航空航班。

en.title: EVA Air wins seven awards, including first report gold at the Global Corporate Sustainability Awards
en.summary: EVA Air received seven sustainability awards, including its first report gold at the Global Corporate Sustainability Awards.
body: EVA Air said it received seven awards at this year's Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Awards, including its first gold in the sustainability report category at the Global Corporate Sustainability Awards (GCSA).

The Taiwan Institute for Sustainable Energy held the 19th Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Awards ceremony in 2026. EVA Air's other awards included a Taiwan Top 100 sustainable enterprise award, platinum in the sustainability report category, and leadership awards for sustainable supply chains and social inclusion.

The airline said it works with Evergreen Sky Catering to recycle used cooking oil. Formosa Petrochemical converts the oil into sustainable aviation fuel through co-processing, and the resulting fuel is used on EVA Air flights, the airline said.
